notes.title: One Strike 1.1 Version!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Samurais, Ninjas and Monks! 
I hope you guys are enjoying the game! I am here to announce a brand new version of the game and what can you expect from it!

[h1]
[b]A brand new duelist: The Oni! A fearsome Tetsubo wielder! [/b][/h1]
[b]The most popular weapon chosen by the fans![/b]

[list]
[*] Three new amazing songs
[*] New stage
[*] Small background changes
[*] New game cover
[/list]  
[h1]
[b]Balacing Changes [/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Soujirou[/b]
- Attack range increased in 30% aproximatelly.
- Defense time decreased in 150%, making him less static.

[*] [b]Bailong[/b]
- Attack speed doubled.
- Backdash range incresed 30% aproximatelly.
[/list]
